features.name: Mount Clare Museum House
features.description: Mount Clare Museum House is the historic mansion and interpreted former plantation landscape on the eastern rise of Carroll Park, with a collection and grounds addressing the Carroll family, enslaved people, indentured servants and transported convicts who lived and worked there.
